## 🔄 Area to Refactor
Describe which part of the codebase needs refactoring (file, module, feature, etc.).

## ❓ Current Problem
Explain what is wrong with the current implementation.
- Hard to read?
- Difficult to maintain?
- Performance issues?
- Technical debt?

## ✅ Proposed Refactor
Describe how you think the code should be refactored.
- Patterns to introduce/remove
- Files to split/merge
- APIs to change

## 🎯 Expected Benefits
What improvements will this refactor bring?
- Readability
- Maintainability
- Performance
- Testability

## 📎 Additional Context
Add any other context, links, or screenshots here.
